It names no AWS image registry or deploy pipeline, so none is drawn.<br><br><b>Open (S4-01)</b><br>Is a production cluster available? Does AWS start clean or take the test-host data? Without a DNS name, Google SSO does not work and the dashboard has the IP allowlist only.<br><br>Only the load balancer is reachable from the internet. div.div:
Changed from the plan: one PostgreSQL 17 instance holds both databases (plan: 18 for the monitor, a separate 17 for Langfuse).
Plan A is drawn
Plan B, if RDS and S3 are not approved by 21 October: PostgreSQL and MinIO run in the cluster.
Not stated in the plan
The plan says "AWS Kubernetes cluster"; the EKS icon is an assumption. It names no AWS image registry or deploy pipeline, so none is drawn.
Open (S4-01)
Is a production cluster available? Does AWS start clean or take the test-host data? Without a DNS name, Google SSO does not work and the dashboard has the IP allowlist only.
Only the load balancer is reachable from the internet. Langfuse web and worker both use PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and S3.
